description: EPQuery is a Python tool from the University of Southern Denmark for exploring and editing large EnergyPlus IDF files. It queries a model, selects objects and applies basic edits or user-supplied functions to the selected objects. The README gives adding schedules and external-interface objects as examples of repetitive tasks it can automate. Source, installation commands and linked documentation are publicly available through GitHub, with Python package installation also documented. The software is free under BSD-2-Clause. Coverage is any compatible user-supplied building model; geography, weather period and simulation resolution remain properties of the IDF and associated inputs. A stated limitation is its pre-release status. Editing inputs does not itself establish a valid building model, and the review did not test object transformations against a particular EnergyPlus version. EPQuery helps prepare batches of building scenarios and set up control or co-simulation interfaces. It is a preparation tool for the catalogue's EnergyPlus model (model-energyplus), whose solver remains responsible for the thermal and energy calculations.
